attchmntText: Hindustan Copper Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Board Comments on Notice received from BSE and NSE for payment of fine for non-compliance of corporate governance requirement of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'.
voiceSummary: Hindustan Copper Limited received notices from BSE and NSE on 25.08.2026 imposing a fine of Rs. 14,43,140 each for non-compliance with SEBI LODR Regulations regarding board composition for the quarter ended 30.09.2026. The company states that director appointments are pending with the Ministry of Mines. The Board discussed this at its meeting on 11.11.2026. The company has requested the exchanges to exempt it from paying the fine under the Uniform Carve Out Policy.

attchmntText: Hindustan Copper Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Hindustan Copper Limited Board approved Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 11th November 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 1175.24 crore for the quarter and 2111.74 crore for the half year. Profit before tax stood at 695.43 crore for the quarter and 1167.20 crore for the half year. Net profit was 519.54 crore for the quarter and 872.15 crore for the half year. Earnings per share were 5.37 for the quarter and 9.02 for the half year. Total assets as at 30th September 2026 were 5236.26 crore. Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the half year were 1273.56 crore. The results were reviewed by Statutory Auditors P. A. & Associates.
